3. Considering the proximity of potential facilities and the available job market, please clarify if the above percentages are a commitment or a goal/target? Please choose:

___ Commitment

_x__ Goal/Target

Bally’s projects that Bally’s Bronx will create 3,741 new permanent positions and employ 2,876 full-time and 865 part-time workers, or approximately 3,503 full-time equivalents (FTE). Median compensation is estimated to be near $80,000, including benefits; the compensation package seems low compared to the other Applicants. The Applicant states that 70 percent of employees will be Bronx residents, 47 percent will be women, and 75 percent will be minorities.
As previously outlined in our RFA materials, public presentation materials and elsewhere throughout this process, we have committed to hiring at least 70%+ Bronx residents as a minimum target.

Our minimum goal for residents of New York State will be inclusive of our targets for Bronx based hiring. We anticipate that our minimum target goal will be that 70% of our employees will be from the Bronx or from local, historically underserved populations.
